# Analysis of All Performed Cyanine Computations 

## Few Remarks:

Only the bolded sections were referenced in the main paper. 

Section \#1: Unused due to having used an incorrect structure that lacked substituents and gem-dimethyls, and lacked a CPCM. 

Section \#2: Unused in favor of Section \#6 due to changing to a CPCM methanol solvation model for excitations.

Section \#3: Unused in favor of Section \#6 due to changing to a CPCM water solvation model for geometrical optimization.

**Section \#4: Main computation used for the Cy5 series.**

**Section \#5: Main computation used for the Cy7 series.**

**Section \#6: Main computation used for the Cy3 series.**

Section \#7: Unused in favor of Section \#9 due to an incorrectly optimized final model that included cis transfigurations in the central carbon chain. 

Section \#8: Unused in favor of Section \#10 due to an incorrectly optimized final model that included cis transfigurations in the central carbon chain. 

**Section \#9: Main computation used for the Cy9 series.**

**Section \#10: Main computation used for the Cy11 series.**


## 1 \- Cy3 (Simple):

\! B3LYP D3BJ def2-SVP def2/J RIJCOSX Opt Freq TightSCF

## 2 \- Cy3 (Methyl Substituents, CPCM Water): 

### **\#5: Cy3 (N-CH3) B3LYP Excited State Calculations, Methyl Substituent, CPCM (Water) Solvent** 

Recognized error with prior model of Cy3 (missing methyl substituents, missing gem-dimethyl groups). Reoptimized models for greater accuracy to real models, as found in the supplementary information from [this paper.](https://pubs.acs.org/jpcafh/article-abstract/125/36/7852/599033/Accurate-Modeling-of-Excitonic-Coupling-in-Cyanine?redirectedFrom=fulltext) Also added CPCM to the input during optimization.

Prior model (bond orders omitted):  
![][image5]  
New model:  
![][image6] 

**Base Folder:** 2-cy3-met-water/cy3-5-B3LYP

**Optimization Command:** See 2-cy3-met-water/cy3-met-opt

\! B3LYP D3BJ def2-SVP def2/J RIJCOSX Opt Freq TightSCF CPCM(Water)

% geom  
    MaxIter 500  
end
